summary: Per-wheel steering geometry update. Converts steering input a3 to radians, perturbs it with a noise angle from the flt_8AAE74 trig table indexed by dword_8AAE70, accumulates the steering angle into the per-wheel block (sign differs for front wheels a2==0/3 vs rears), and clamps it to +/-0.1745 rad. When wheel-body contact count (0x15BC) is positive, iterates the contact array (0x15C0, 48-byte stride), matches contacts to the shared suspension selector (0x141C) and transforms contact geometry through the coordinate frames of the matching contact bodies via Matrix3x3VectorMultiply, Mat3x3MulVec and F_3x3MatrixInverseCoordinateTransform. Finally accumulates the steering angle into the wheel offset and, when the accumulated value exceeds 0.015, sets a state flag to 4 in the secondary state struct (0x1F00). Called by CollisionSparkParticleEffects on the per-frame path.

operations.description: Convert steering input a3 to radians: v28 = a3 * 0.08726646259971647 (approximately 5 degrees per unit).
Mark the per-wheel block active: set BYTE1 of wheel entry at index 281*a2+276 to 1.
Build a perturbation angle from the noise/trig table: v5 = flt_8AAE74[dword_8AAE70 & 0xFF] * pi, increment the dword_8AAE70 counter, then v6 = sin(v5) * v28.
Accumulate the steering angle into the wheel block at index 281*a2+279: add for front wheels (a2==0 or a2==3), subtract for rear wheels.

Clamp the accumulated steering angle to +/-0.1745329251994329 rad; when out of range write clamp literals (1069963032 / -1077520616) into the per-wheel 280/282 slots, otherwise snap the angle (279/281) to 1256670343.
Call PhysicsSubObjectFree(this) to release transient per-subobject data before the contact transform pass.
this->wheelContactCount (0x15BC) > 0 enables iteration over the wheel-body contact array at this->wheelContacts (0x15C0) with 48-byte stride.

Iterate contact entries (stride 48) to find the contact whose body id matches the wheel block's contact body id (read at v4+348); on match transform the contact's vector bases through the coordinate frames of the matching contact bodies using Matrix3x3VectorMultiply, Mat3x3MulVec and F_3x3MatrixInverseCoordinateTransform, with the shared suspension selector this->0x141C overriding the target frame for rear contact slots 96/144.
Accumulate the steering angle into the per-wheel accumulated offset at v4+480: value = v28 + *(v4+480).
When the accumulated steering angle exceeds 0.015 and the field at secondary state struct (this+0x1F00) offset +16488 is zero, set that field to 4 (steering state flag 0x5F68).

clean_pseudocode: v5 = flt_8AAE74[dword_8AAE70++ & 0xFF] * PI; v6 = sin(v5) * v28;
this[281*a2+279] += (a2==0 || a2==3) ? v6 : -v6;  // clamp to +/-0.1745 rad, snap literals
for each contact (this->0x15C0, stride 48) if id matches wheel block contact id:
transform contact vectors via Matrix3x3VectorMultiply / Mat3x3MulVec / F_3x3MatrixInverseCoordinateTransform;
